name: Botanist Elsie

intro.text: I'm cataloguing the forest. Every plant, every pest, and an unhealthy number of weeds. Would you like to see how the pests do in battle?

win: Good. I've never seen a bamboo shoot hold its own so well.
after: Ascension's plant life is mostly introduced, which makes it a kind of living museum of the Victorian age and a good, damp, quiet place to think.
